text:
DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
APEX UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Arun Kumar, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2012-2015) at Apex University of Technology.

During this tenure, Arun Kumar demonstrated exceptional mastery in Computer Vision, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Edge AI. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Graph Neural Networks for Large-Scale Knowledge Graph Completion', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Arun Kumar displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Arun Kumar among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Arvind Swaminathan
Professor & Head of Department
Computer Science & Engineering
Apex University of Technology
Email: .arvind.swaminathan@apexuniver.edu
